# StashUI

> An agentic UI library: about 1,100 hand-picked, recorded React + Tailwind components (shadcn registry format) that a coding agent can see, compare and install. The server composes numbered images of components so the agent chooses by look, not from descriptions.

## For agents

- Setup, three commands: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/setup.md
- API, self-describing, no login: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/api/agent/v1
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no login): https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/api/mcp
- CLI, one file, no dependencies: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/agent/stashui.mjs
- Skills: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Whole catalogue as JSON: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/agent/catalog.json
- One component's detail: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/agent/items/<name>.json
- shadcn registry item: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/r/<name>.json (install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/r/<name>.json`)

## Operations

- browse: what exists, by kind; with kinds, one image of the best five of each
- search: one numbered image of matches for a need, plus a line per number
- view: six frames of one component in motion, with props and cost
- board: several picks together in one image, to check they look like one product
- code: source of one component
- add: the install command

## For people

- Gallery: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz
- A component's page: https://stashui.vermarjun.xyz/c/<name>
